description: Estações Rodoviárias - RS is a dataset listed in Brazilian national spatial data infrastructure metadata catalogue (INDE), a metadata catalogue (CSW), published or maintained by Infraestrutura Nacional de Dados Espaciais (INDE). Arquivo vetorial, do tipo "Ponto", das Estações Rodoviárias em operação no Rio Grande do Sul. Coverage: Brasil. Its tags are Estação Rodoviária, Rodoviária, Terminal Rodoviário, Rio Grande do Sul, Downloadable Data. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-csw-inde-portal.
